真正的离别是正月十五这天。

B组杀青，包括沈轩。

影视城的戏份全部结束。

剧组给每个演员都准备了鲜花。

沈轩原本是个小透明，但他的花是田馨亲自送的。

“下次有机会接着带姐姐打游戏！”

“那必须的！”

沈轩接过花，大方地和田馨拥抱。

大家一起拍照合影

杨老爷：“没想到赵相公也知道，万物源自于一的理论；那不知赵相公以为这个一是如何演化五行的呢，又与阴阳何干”？

The real farewell is on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.

Group B is finished, including Shen Xuan.

All the scenes in the film and television city are over.

The crew prepared flowers for each actor.

Shen Xuan was originally a little transparent, but his flowers were sent by Tian Xin personally.

"Next time I have a chance, I'll take my sister to play games!"

"That's necessary!"

Shen Xuan took the flowers and hugged Tian Xin generously.

Let's all take photos together

Mr. Yang: "I didn't expect that Mr. Zhao also knew the theory that all things originate from one. Then I don't know how Mr. Zhao thought this one evolved into the five elements, and what does it have to do with Yin and Yang?"
